// THE PROBLEM WITH PUBLIC AI
Every time your team uses ChatGPT
your business walks out the door.

Contracts pasted in. Customer lists uploaded. Internal strategy shared as “context.” Public AI platforms are trained on data like yours — and there is no taking it back. Euranix AI runs entirely on your data, in your environment. No public model ever sees it. Not one word.

Keep Your Data Private  →
PUBLIC AI
✕
Your data used for training
✕

✕

✕

EURANIX AI
Runs on your infrastructure
Data never leaves your environment
Trained on your specific context
GDPR and compliance ready
// WHY EURANIX AI
WE HANDLE THE
ENTIRE TRANSFORMATION

Legacy systems, scattered data, no internal AI team — none of that is your problem anymore. We come in, we build it, and we keep it running.

We Handle Everything

You bring the data, we do the rest. Euranix designs, deploys, and manages your AI — no technical team required on your end.

Legacy Software? No Problem

Already running on custom or older systems? We integrate directly into your existing software stack. No rip-and-replace.

Instant Answers From Your Data

Your team asks in plain English, your AI answers from your actual documents, databases, and records — in seconds.

24/7 Customer Support AI

Embed a branded AI assistant on your website. It handles customer questions around the clock using your own knowledge base.

Your Data Stays Private

Nothing leaves your environment without your say. We support fully private, on-premise deployments — your data, your rules.

Built For Your Business

Not a generic tool. Your AI is configured around your industry, your workflows, and your language from day one.

// HOW IT WORKS
UP AND RUNNING
IN 50 MINUTES

We do the heavy lifting. You get a working AI that understands your business — without hiring a single data scientist.

01
We Audit Your Data & Systems

We start by understanding your business — your data sources, existing software, and what your team actually needs answers to.

Works with your existing stack
02
We Build & Deploy Your AI

Euranix connects your data sources, configures your private AI, and deploys it — cloud or on-premise. You do nothing technical.

Live in under 50 minutes
03
Your Team Just Asks

From day one your team gets precise answers from your own data. Ask by text or voice. We monitor, update, and keep it sharp over time.

Ongoing managed by Euranix
// REAL WORLD USE CASES
BUILT FOR
REAL BUSINESS

Every industry has data trapped in the wrong places. We free it. Here is how Euranix transforms different types of businesses.

MOST POPULAR
Your Entire Business Knowledge, Answering Questions

We take everything your business knows — documents, SOPs, meeting notes, policies — and turn it into an AI your whole team can query instantly. New staff productive in hours, not weeks.

We ingest all your existing docs — no reformatting needed
AI answers sourced directly from your content, with references
Ask by voice or text, from any device
Controlled sharing — not everyone sees everything
We maintain and update it as your business evolves
// LIVE DEMO
You: What's our warranty policy for international orders?


AI: Based on your policy document (updated March 2025), international orders carry a 12-month warranty. Replacements sent within 14 business days...


You: Can you summarize la|
CUSTOMER SUPPORT
AI Support, Live on Your Website

We deploy a branded AI assistant directly on your site. It resolves customer queries from your own product docs and history — zero wait time, 24/7.

Trained on your FAQs, docs, and past support tickets
Seamlessly escalates complex cases to your team
Branded to match your product — we handle the setup
DATABASE & ANALYTICS
Query Your Data in Plain English

We connect Euranix to your live database. Your team asks business questions directly — no SQL, no analysts in the loop for simple queries.

"Which customers haven't ordered in 90 days?"
"What's our margin on product X this quarter?"
Supports MySQL, PostgreSQL, and more
LEGACY INTEGRATION
AI Inside Your Existing Software

Running on older or custom-built systems? We integrate AI directly into your current software — via API or embedded chat. No rebuild, no migration.

Full API integration — we manage it end-to-end
AI embedded inside your existing workflows
Works alongside the tools your team already uses
ANY INDUSTRY
Tell Us Your Problem. We'll Solve It.

Clinics, logistics firms, law offices, manufacturers — we have worked across industries. Bring us your challenge and we will design the solution.

Policy and compliance Q&A for regulated industries
Contract review and document summarization
Internal HR assistants, onboarding bots, and more
// PLATFORM FEATURES
EVERYTHING YOUR
TEAM NEEDS

One platform, fully managed by us. Every feature below comes deployed, configured, and maintained by Euranix — not left on your team to figure out.

Managed Deployment

We deploy, configure, and maintain your AI. No devops, no internal expertise needed — just results.

Any Data Source

Databases, documents, legacy systems, cloud storage — we connect it all. Your data does not need to move.

Domain-Specific AI Agents

Separate agents for support, ops, HR, and sales — each trained on the right data, all managed centrally.

Website AI Assistant

A branded chat widget on your site, trained on your products. We build it, deploy it, and keep it accurate.

Always Up to Date

Auto-sync from your database or S3. As your data changes, your AI stays current — no manual re-training.

Voice & Text

Your team interacts however they prefer — type a question or speak it. Both work out of the box.

Usage Intelligence

See exactly what your team asks, track answer quality, and identify gaps. We use this to continuously improve your AI.

Private by Default

Cloud, private cloud, or fully on-premise — your data never feeds public AI models, ever.

Structured Knowledge

Beyond Q&A — create structured SOPs, meeting summaries, and policy docs that are instantly queryable.

// PRICING
SIMPLE,
HONEST PRICING

Flat monthly fee. No per-seat charges, no hidden costs. Every plan includes setup and ongoing management by Euranix.

STARTER

per month, flat rate
Up to 10 team members
1 managed AI agent
Ingest PDFs, docs, spreadsheets and URLs
Chat interface and smart notes
10GB knowledge base storage
Euranix-managed setup and deployment
Email support

BUSINESS

per month, flat rate
Up to 50 team members
5 AI agents with custom personas
Everything in Starter

Voice interface
Branded website chat widget
Auto-sync from S3 or database
50GB storage with usage analytics
Priority support

tailored to your business

Everything in Business
